propositions: Whitespace-only boundary or trailing edits to no_file_impact_reason change the plan-review material fingerprint and incorrectly invalidate signed attestations as stale-material, violating the documented whitespace-normalization invariant.
material_basis() canonicalizes the description field but inserts no_file_impact_reason byte-for-byte without normalization, causing the raw reason bytes to diverge on insignificant whitespace.

The fix must thread a normalize_reason parameter through material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl while preserving three historical raw-reason generations in _legacy_material_ok for backward compatibility.

Boundary and trailing whitespace variants of no_file_impact_reason must produce identical current fingerprints and certified attestation status, while interior whitespace or word changes remain material and produce stale-material.

Pre-330c, post-330c/pre-2be7, and post-2be7/pre-fix attestations with their respective canonicalization states must continue matching their historical fingerprints via explicit normalize_reason=False overrides in legacy candidates.
